priorFindings.FIND-006 (iter1) / FIND-001 (iter2): RESOLVED — behavioral-spec.md:59-65 (REQ-16) now names a CONCRETE zero-human mechanism for the Sprint-2 target rail: note = authenticated GET of the note sales-management endpoint the creator dashboard calls, via the stored NOTE_SESSION_COOKIE (not a claimed 'public API'); Substack = Stripe charge/balance API via a stored key; bank withdrawal is explicitly moved out of the runtime gate as a one-time install fact. The residual risk (session-cookie expiry mid-loop triggering a login/2FA challenge) is covered generically by REQ-13 ('any sub-step would need a human runtime action THEN the skill SHALL substitute an autonomous path ... or SHALL NOT count that rail toward earn'), so the mechanism is no longer a hand-wave.

FIXED set of BINARY criteria; PASS = ALL true' with 5 named sub-criteria (a)-(e), giving PROP-5 a concrete, restatable threshold that did not exist before. priorFindings.FIND-004 (iter2): NOT-RESOLVED (partial) — verification-architecture.md:37 (PROP-15) now tests the round-count-ceiling half of REQ-14 ('stub 3 fails -> assert abort + zero publish calls'), but the 'record the failure' half of REQ-14's SHALL clause (behavioral-spec.md:71-73) still has zero proof-obligation coverage anywhere in the table. priorFindings.FIND-005 (iter2): RESOLVED — behavioral-spec.md:10-16 (REQ-2) now explicitly extends the install-time carve-out to name 'the platform account itself' (citing REQ-11's note/phone-gated-X example by name) alongside the payout identity, exactly closing the ambiguity between 'payout identity' and 'platform account' the finding raised.

summary: 4 of the 5 carried-forward defects (iter1 FIND-006/008/009 and iter2 FIND-005) are genuinely closed by concrete spec-text changes, not relocated or narrowed-away as in the prior round. Every REQ, including REQ-4b, now maps to at least one PROP, and the note-sales zero-human read is now a nameable, testable mechanism rather than a hand-wave. However the round is not clean: (1) iter2 FIND-004 is only half-fixed -- PROP-15 proves the 3-round abort ceiling but never asserts REQ-14's 'record the failure' clause against any checkable artifact (FIND-002, major); (2) REQ-5's own claim that V0.5 is a 'REPRODUCIBLE ... FIXED ... BINARY' gate is undercut by criterion (e) ('majority of sentences are short and mobile-scannable'), which alone lacks any objective threshold while the sibling criteria (a)-(d) each have one -- this is a narrower, internally-inconsistent version of the original non-reproducibility defect, not a new category of problem (FIND-001, major); (3) the newly-added required PROP-15 is not enumerated in either sprint's proof-obligation bullet list, leaving its delivery point ambiguous for strict-mode convergence tracking (FIND-003, minor). spec_fidelity FAILs on FIND-001 (internal contradiction in REQ-5's reproducibility claim); verification_readiness FAILs on FIND-002 and FIND-003 (incomplete proof coverage of a required, SHALL-level clause and an unscheduled required PROP). None of the three remaining findings are blocker-severity, and the spec is materially closer to convergence than iteration 2, but strict mode's zero-open-findings bar is not yet met.
